text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
Hey, tell me, have you seen Inori anywhere?
Honestly... every time the boss wants her...
Where's she run off to this time...?
choice_data_list: You actually get along pretty well, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なあキミ、
イノリのやつみなかったか？
ったくよぉ、
ボスが呼んでるって時にアイツ、
いったいどこ行ったんだか……

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
What, Inori...? Well, what you see's what you get.
She's a hopeless midget with no concept of respect.
But y'know, she's a good kid really. Be nice to her, OK?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どういう、
って……
まあ
見たまんまだよ。
ヘタレでまぬけで
口が悪いちんちくりん……
でもさ、
根は良いやつなんだ。
仲良くしてやってくれよな。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're telling me! She's got these big... ambitions?
Like, it's cool how she always tries to get one over on the boss,
but I wish she'd pull herself together a bit more.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなんだよな～、
上昇志向ってやつ？
なんか一発かましてやろう
って心意気はいいんだけどさ、
もうちょっとしっかりしてくれると助かるよな。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
I just can't take my eyes off her. I'd worry, y'know?
She's a bit like you in that way. I bet you two get along.
And it's definitely never boring around her. That's like you, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんかほっとけないんだよな。
危なっかしくてさ。
そういうとこは
キミと似てるかも。
イノリとは気が合うだろ？
面白いやつだから一緒にいて飽きないとこも、
キミと同じだしな！
